label: Случай
description: A 10-sentence usage card for случай (case; occasion).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Случай' is a masculine noun ending in soft -й, here nominative as the predicate. 'Редкий' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A natural way to label an occurrence.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Случай' is the accusative direct object of 'помню'; the inanimate masculine accusative matches the nominative. 'Интересный' agrees in masculine and 'один' counts it.

Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. 'Случая' is the genitive singular after 'не было', with the soft-stem ending -я. 'Подходящего' agrees in the masculine genitive, meaning there was no suitable occasion.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'благодаря'. 'Случаю' is the dative singular required by 'благодаря', meaning thanks to chance. The soft-stem dative ending is -ю, and 'познакомились' tells the result.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Случаем' is the instrumental singular required by 'воспользуйся', meaning seize the opportunity. 'Удобным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in an idiom. 'В случае' uses the prepositional 'случае' after 'в' in the common phrase in this case. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, framing a condition.

Strategic focus: Prepositional with following genitive. 'В случае' is the prepositional form in the conditional phrase in case of. 'Дождя' is genitive, naming the event, meaning if it rains we stay home.

Strategic focus: Accusative in a fixed phrase. 'Случай' is accusative after 'на' in the idiom на всякий случай, meaning just in case; the inanimate accusative matches the nominative. 'Всякий' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Случаи' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'бывают'. 'Такие' agrees in the plural and 'редко' adds frequency. This noun pluralizes readily as cases.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantity word. 'Случаев' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько', with the soft-stem ending -ев. 'Похожих' agrees in the plural genitive, meaning several similar cases.
